req.title: PUT is idempotent
req.statement: The system shall produce the same terminal state when PUT is repeated with the same body for the same task_id.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states PUT /tasks/{task_id} must be idempotent: repeating the same PUT with the same body must yield the same terminal state. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — two identical PUTs produce identical response bodies and HTTP 200; (2) positive STC — state transition from incomplete to complete is stable across repeated PUTs; (3) boundary BVA — PUT with max-length title (100 chars) and max-length description (500 chars) is idempotent; (4) negative NEG — PUT to a non-existent task_id returns 404 both times (idempotency of error path); (5) DT — PUT with only one optional field set is idempotent (partial update). Each test uses an in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB, seeds exactly the pre-loaded rows needed, and asserts exact field values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_put_idempotent_positive_same_response_twice
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists: title='Fix login bug', completed=false
Database is seeded with pre-loaded rows
actions: PUT /tasks/7 with body {title: 'Fix login bug', description: 'updated desc', completed: true}
Record second response body and status
expected: Both response bodies have identical id, title, description, completed values
title == 'Fix login bug' in both responses
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
db_path = os.path.join(tmp, 'test.db')
os.environ['DATABASE_URL'] = f'sqlite:///{db_path}'

import app.database as _db
_db.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = f'sqlite:///{db_path}'
_db.engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{db_path}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
_db.SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=_db.engine)

from app import models
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=_db.engine)

from app.main import app
client = TestClient(app)

create_r = client.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Fix login bug', 'description': 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', 'completed': False})
assert create_r.status_code == 201
task_id = create_r.json()['id']

payload = {'title': 'Fix login bug', 'description': 'updated desc', 'completed': True}
r1 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=payload)
assert r1.status_code == 200
b1 = r1.json()
assert b1['id'] == task_id
assert b1['title'] == 'Fix login bug'
assert b1['description'] == 'updated desc'
assert b1['completed'] == True

r2 = client.put(f'/tasks/{task_id}', json=payload)
assert r2.status_code == 200
b2 = r2.json()
assert b2['id'] == task_id
assert b2['title'] == 'Fix login bug'
assert b2['description'] == 'updated desc'
assert b2['completed'] == True
assert b1['id'] == b2['id']
assert b1['title'] == b2['title']
assert b1['description'] == b2['description']
assert b1['completed'] == b2['completed']

def test_put_idempotent_positive_same_response_twice():

import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
db_path = os.path.join(tmp, 'test2.db')

import app.database as _db2
_db2.SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = f'sqlite:///{db_path}'
_db2.engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{db_path}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
_db2.SessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=_db2.engine)

from app import models as _models2
_models2.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=_db2.engine)

from app.main import app as _app2
client2 = TestClient(_app2)

cr = client2.post('/tasks/', json={'title': 'Write project report', 'description': None, 'completed': False})
assert cr.status_code == 201
tid = cr.json()['id']
assert cr.json()['completed'] == False

payload = {'title': 'Write project report', 'completed': True}

    assert body['completed'] == True
    assert body['title'] == 'Write project report'
    assert body['id'] == tid
    rg = client2.get(f'/tasks/{tid}')
    assert rg.status_code == 200
    assert rg.json()['completed'] == True
    assert rg.json()['title'] == 'Write project report'
